armorhud.tooltip.style: How the slot backgrounds are drawn. Try another style if the slots look wrong with your resource pack.
armorhud.tooltip.widgetShown: Always: every slot. If Any Present: all slots when any armour is worn. Not Empty: only filled slots. Damaged Pieces: only pieces at the warning.
armorhud.tooltip.showIcons: Show the empty-slot icons in empty slots (needs Always or If Any Present).
armorhud.tooltip.mainHandDura: Show the durability of the held item above its hotbar slot (needs a text display, not Bar).
armorhud.tooltip.side: The screen side the widget is on. Does nothing at Top Center.
armorhud.tooltip.offsetX: Moves the widget horizontally, away from its anchor when positive.
armorhud.tooltip.offsetY: Moves the widget vertically, away from its anchor when positive; down when positive at Vertical Center.
armorhud.tooltip.offhandSlotBehavior: How the widget beside the hotbar reacts to the offhand slot and the attack indicator.
armorhud.tooltip.pushBossbars: At Top Center, boss bars are pushed down by the widget.
armorhud.tooltip.pushIcons: At the top right, effect icons are pushed down by the widget.
armorhud.tooltip.pushSubtitles: At the bottom right, subtitles are pushed up by the widget.
armorhud.tooltip.showWarning: Show a small warning at a piece with low durability.
armorhud.tooltip.minDuraValue: A piece with this much durability left or less warns.
armorhud.tooltip.minDuraPercent: A piece with this share of durability left or less warns.
armorhud.tooltip.iconBobIntensity: How far the warning icon jitters; 0 keeps it still.
armorhud.tooltip.playBreakSound: Play a sound when a worn piece wears down to the warning.
